newsitem.title: REPUBLIC OF IRELAND: Dublin gains 950 jobs from Citibank investment.
newsitem.headline: Dublin gains 950 jobs from Citibank investment.

text.p: Ireland's minister for Enterprise and Employment, Richard Bruton said on Wednesday that Citibank, a unit of Citicorp, had concluded negotiations with IDA Ireland on a proposal which would initially create 450 new jobs, with a target of 950 jobs on completion.

The minister said Citibank's new project in Dublin, a European processing centre, would support the bank's Global Transaction Service and would be run in conjunction with Citibank's existing activities in Ireland.
The IDA said in a statement that the venture will offer services such as management of transactions relating to client cash movements, European security services and international trade.
"Winning this project for Ireland will encourage the managers of other financial business to promote Dublin in their corporate strategic plans for the next century," Bruton said.
